description.zh: 获取云盘的秒级监控数据的结束时间点。按照[ISO 8601](~~25696~~)标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`。
description.en: The end of the time range during which you want to query the near real-time monitoring data of the disk. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

description.zh:
获取云盘的秒级监控数据的间隔时间。单位：秒。取值范围：

- 5。
- 60。

默认值：5。
description.en:
The interval at which the near real-time monitoring data is collected. Unit: seconds. Valid values:

*   5
*   60

Default value: 5.
The region ID of the disk.

description.zh: 获取云盘的秒级监控数据的起始时间点。按照[ISO 8601](~~25696~~)标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`。
description.en: The beginning of the time range during which you want to query the near real-time monitoring data of the disk. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

description.zh:
磁盘监控数据类型。取值范围：

- basic：基础性能数据。

- pro：包含Burst IO数据。
description.en:
The type of the monitoring data. Valid values:

*   basic: baseline performance data.
*   pro: burst performance data, such as burst I/O operations.

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明

- 查询结果一次最多返回400条数据，即指定的`（EndTime-StartTime）/Period`不能超过400。

- 查询结果一次最多能查询近3天内的监控信息，即`StartTime`指定的时间与当前时间相差不能超过3天。
descriptions.en:
## Usage notes

*   CloudLens for EBS is in invitational preview in the China (Hangzhou), China (Shanghai), China (Zhangjiakou), China (Shenzhen), and China (Hong Kong) regions. To use the feature, [submit a ticket](https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/#/ticket/createIndex).
*   Up to 400 monitoring data entries can be returned at a time. An error is returned if the value calculated based on the following formula is greater than 400: `(EndTime - StartTime)/Period`.
*   You can query the monitoring data collected in the last three days. An error is returned if the time specified by `StartTime` is more than three days prior to the current time.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ebs describe-disk-monitor-data --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --disk-id d-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --start-time 2022-06-01T03:00:00Z --end-time 2022-06-01T05:00:00Z --period 5 --type basic --region cn-hangzhou
